resolutions.answer: Exactly two probe-exercised behaviors are determined by format.md differently from reference.py, and none is left wholly undetermined without also differing: (1) pair ordering — format.md mandates mapping/insertion order ('the order in which they appear in the mapping') while reference.py sorts keys (sorted(d)); exercised by probes 1, 5, 6. (2) backslash treatment — format.md's exhaustive escaping clause names only ';' and '=', so a literal backslash passes through unchanged, while reference.py doubles every backslash first; exercised by probe 4. All other exercised behaviors (key=value rendering, ';' joining, '='/';' escaping in keys and values including trailing position, empty key/value rendering, empty mapping to empty line) are determined identically; behavior-statement.md gives the clause-by-clause enumeration covering every probe and the explicit argument that the inventory is exhaustive.
